subject: Mythology
title: Izanagi and Izanami: Creating Japan
description: One-minute skill: Izanagi and Izanami: Creating Japan.

hook.text: Japan was born when two gods stirred the ocean with a jeweled spear and let the drops form solid islands.

buildup.text: Izanagi and Izanami were brother and sister, sent by the elder gods to create the physical world below.

discovery.text: They married and gave birth to the islands of Japan, the mountains, rivers, and eventually the gods of nature.

twist.text: Izanami died giving birth to fire. Izanagi traveled to the underworld to bring her back but found her rotting.

climax.text: He fled in horror, sealing the underworld shut. She vowed to kill a thousand people a day in revenge.

punchline.text: Japan's creation myth begins with love and ends with death chasing the living.

quiz.question: How did Izanagi and Izanami create the islands of Japan?
options: They carved them from a giant mountain
They stirred the ocean with a jeweled spear and drops formed islands
They called the islands up from the ocean floor with a song
